thread:
Sam: Quick follow-up from today's all‑hands on security/compliance. A few teams asked for concrete timelines and owners for SOC2 evidence, BYO KMS, VPC/private connectivity options, and audit log retention. Can we capture action items here?

Isha: Thanks — happy to sync. High level answers: SOC2 evidence package (initial) by end of next quarter; BYO KMS (customer-managed keys) roadmap in engineering review, target beta in ~8 weeks; audit logs retention extension configurable up to 1 year coming as feature flag.

Jordan: For Private deployments: AWS PrivateLink + VPC endpoints is our recommended path for customers that need no Internet egress. We also support VPC peering for older accounts but it requires extra routing work.

Maggie: For ISO evidence: legal/security can start mapping controls to current artifacts. We need exports of: KMS key policies, auditlog retention settings, access reviews. If infra can send the sample exports, we can start drafting evidence templates.

Sam: Can we list owners and short due dates? People want a single place to check progress.

Isha: Owners & short DRI list: SOC2 evidence: Isha (sec) + Kira (compliance) — initial package by 2026-06-15. BYO KMS beta: Jordan (infra) + Sam (product) — beta by 2026-05-20. VPC PrivateLink doc + checklist: Jordan (infra) — doc by 2026-05-01. Audit-log retention flag: Kira (compliance) + Jordan — feature rollout by 2026-05-10.

Jordan: Adding technical notes: PrivateLink requires us to publish a service name per region and update terraform modules. Example endpoint policy snippet we will publish in the doc:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodPrivateAccess"}, "Action": "execute-api:Invoke", "Resource": "*"}]
}```

Kira: For audit logs, we'll keep the default at 90 days but expose a tenant-level setting to increase up to 365 days. Need UX from product for retention slider and export endpoints.

Maggie: One compliance nuance — for SOC2 we need proof of key rotation policy and HSM usage where applicable. If BYO KMS customers use an external HSM, we need documented attestation. Isha, can security create a short checklist for customers?

Isha: Yes — will draft a customer checklist: key policy review, rotation cadence, KMS grants, HSM attestation template. Sharing draft by 2026-04-28.

Sam: Great. Can we set a recurring weekly 30m office hours for compliance questions until SOC2 milestone is done? Prefer Tuesdays 9am PT.

Jordan: Works for infra — will book a recurring slot and invite legal/security.

Security-Bot: Automated scan report: found 3 infra accounts without explicit KMS key policy statements in the last 24h. Created ticket INFRA-4823.

Kira: I'll triage INFRA-4823 with Jordan tomorrow.

Sam: Action items recap (high level):
- SOC2 evidence package -> Isha + Kira -> due 2026-06-15
- BYO KMS beta -> Jordan + Sam -> due 2026-05-20
- PrivateLink + VPC doc -> Jordan -> due 2026-05-01
- Audit log retention flag -> Kira + Jordan -> due 2026-05-10
- Customer KMS/HSM checklist -> Isha -> draft 2026-04-28
- Weekly office hours Tuesdays 9am PT -> Jordan to schedule

Sam: If anyone needs to swap ownership or adjust dates, reply here. Otherwise I'll consolidate into a Confluence page and ping everyone once live. :thumbsup:

Maggie: I'll add required sample artifacts for ISO mapping to the confluence page — will upload a template folder.

Jordan: Posting PR for terraform module changes later today. Will link here when ready.

Sam: Thanks all. Appreciated — this will help us be more transparent for customers and sales during pre‑sales.

Kira: :+1: will follow up with meeting invite for legal/compliance walkthrough and share draft evidence checklist.
